highlights.title: From owner intent to a governed, reusable integration
highlights.description: Builder Agent M1 turns guided owner intent into typed discovery, exact capability reuse or inactive unresolved-intent proposals, a digest-bound plan, reviewable contracts and independently checked reversible evidence.

useCases.title: Build a governed integration for a synthetic system
inputs: An owner-selected SAFE_GUIDED, CUSTOM or RAMPAGE_FULL_CONTROL_LAB profile
A synthetic system manifest, System Advisor Guide and bounded goal
A typed capability registry and current constraints
steps: Discover the system and its relevant cause, effect and context records.
Reuse an exact registered capability or emit an inactive UNRESOLVED_INTENT proposal for a genuine gap.
Create a digest-bound integration plan, manifests, dependency graph, reviewable Diff, contracts, fixtures and rollback plan.
Run independent tests, negative probes, readback, reconciliation and receipt checks before any separately routed effect.
expectedOutcomes: Effective rights equal the intersection of the host and system ceiling, owner profile, assignments and current constraints.
One target-neutral core is reused byte-identically across two synthetic system types.
The isolated default-off OpenClaw proof completes one read and one reversible write, records denials and receipts, resets exactly and leaves zero owned residue.
The contribution bundle remains sanitized, opt-in and unable to promote local validation to release status.
useCases.demoUtility: Shows how an operator can inspect and adapt a reusable governed integration without granting new authority or connecting a real system.

controls.description: Owner-selected profiles never exceed the real host/system ceiling, assignments or current constraints.
Installation, activation, mutation and publication remain separate quality and evidence routes.
Contribution is inactive, sanitized and opt-in by default; local validation cannot become release status.

claims.statement: Builder Agent M1 locally validates a reusable path from owner intent through typed discovery, exact capability reuse or inactive unresolved intent, digest-bound planning, validation, reversible execution evidence and sanitized contribution preparation.

nonClaims.statement: This local PoC uses synthetic evidence and is not production-ready, customer evidence or proof of universal target compatibility.
Builder Agent M1 cannot invent host or target-system authority, self-approve or grant permission to connect a real system.

claims.statement: The isolated default-off OpenClaw reference proof locally validates one read, one reversible write, denials, receipts, exact reset and zero owned residue against synthetic targets.

nonClaims.statement: The isolated synthetic proof is not a security certification, hostile-host containment result or production assurance.

claims.statement: The contribution bundle is locally validated as sanitized, opt-in, issue/claim/evidence-linked and structurally unable to represent local validation as release status.

nonClaims.statement: No company data, raw prompt, secret or contribution bundle is automatically uploaded or published.

tests.command: Run the focused BLD-001 contract, runtime and conformance tests

negativeProbes.command: Attempt a direct target effect outside Gateway and Broker
Attempt secret reflection and cross-tenant access
Attempt unauthorized skill activation and self-approval
Force rollback readback failure and require non-success evidence
Attempt private-path leakage and release-status escalation through the contribution bundle

knownLimitations: v0.1.0 is a historical predecessor only and is not the current public release.
Local proof of concept with synthetic evidence only.
No production or customer-system evidence is included.
Not production-ready and not a security certification.
No proof of universal target, adapter or hostile-host compatibility.
No autonomous authority expansion and no permission to connect real systems.
Registry signatures, complete provenance, complete SBOM, current vulnerability status and complete licence clearance are outside this repository-only proof.
externalGates: Release publication requires the authorized protected-main workflow, required current CI and exact merged-byte verification.
Any real-system, production or customer mutation requires separate authorization and evidence.
YouTube upload and social posting remain outside this release workflow.
